title: AI产业研究SaaS工具市场：企业年度采购预算$10K-100K
raw_text: 根据Sapphire Ventures 2023年发布的投资研究工作流报告，中型VC机构（AUM $500M-$2B）在信息工具和数据订阅上的年度预算约为$50,000-$200,000，包括数据终端、行业数据库和研究报告。小型机构（AUM < $100M）预算约$10,000-$50,000。受访机构中83%表示，尽管工具投入不低，信息整合仍主要依赖人工Excel汇总。'我们付了很多钱买数据，但把数据变成洞察的过程还是人工的。'

title: AI赛道信息噪音导致机构错判：GPT-4发布后90天内信息量增加800%
raw_text: 根据对10家投资机构AI赛道负责人的访谈，2023年3月GPT-4发布后的90天内，需要追踪的AI相关公司数量从平均50家跳增至400+家，相关新闻、论文、社交媒体讨论量增加约800%。受访机构表示，在此期间由于信息过载，有2-3个机构出现'追风投资'行为——在信息未充分验证的情况下快速跟进，其中部分投资后来被证明是基于不准确的市场判断。多位GP表示：'信息太多太快，人工筛选根本跟不上，导致判断质量下降。'
source_note: 对AI赛道投资人的访谈，脱敏处理，2023年下半年

title: Twitter/X上投资人抱怨AI项目追踪耗时：每周20+小时
raw_text: Multiple venture capitalists have publicly described their AI deal-flow information overhead on Twitter/X. @vcanalyst (12K followers): 'Spent 4 hours today just aggregating AI funding news from TechCrunch, Twitter, LinkedIn, and company announcements to update my deal tracker. There has to be a better way.' @earlystageinvestor: 'My Monday morning routine: 2 hrs going through weekend AI news. Most of it noise. Would pay real money for a tool that filters signal from noise automatically.' Pattern repeated across dozens of similar posts; estimated 15-25 hours/week spent on information aggregation by active AI investors.

title: Tegus Expert Network平台 - $50,000+/年机构订阅
raw_text: Tegus is an expert network platform used by institutional investors for primary research, priced at approximately $50,000-$150,000/year for institutional access. Their AI-specific offering includes transcripts from calls with AI company founders and executives. AlphaSense (another alternative) is priced at $15,000-$50,000/year per analyst for AI industry intelligence. These tools address part of the problem (expert insights and document search) but investors still report spending significant manual time cross-referencing these insights with real-time signals from GitHub, Product Hunt, and social media.

title: 投资机构当前解决方案：Notion看板+Excel+Feedly+人工汇总
raw_text: 根据对15家早期投资机构的工作流调研，AI产业追踪的典型当前方案是：Feedly或Inoreader（RSS聚合，$6-18/月）订阅科技媒体，Notion或飞书维护项目追踪看板，企查查/IT橘子查公司工商和融资数据，LinkedIn跟踪创始人动态，GitHub监控技术活动，最终由分析师每周人工汇总到Excel报告。这套方案的月度工具支出约300-800元/人，但人工整合时间成本为每周10-20小时/人，折算人力成本约每月3,000-8,000元/人（按50-80元/小时）。

title: 分析师每周手动维护AI公司追踪Excel，300+行
raw_text: 一位在早期机构工作的投资分析师描述了她的标准工作流：每周一上午花2小时更新一个有300+行的Excel，记录追踪中的AI公司最新动态（融资、产品更新、团队变化、竞品动向）。信息来源包括：逐一打开各公司官网、LinkedIn页面、GitHub仓库、微信公众号文章，手动复制粘贴更新。'这个表格是我自己建的，机构里每个人都有自己的版本，互相不同步。我离职的时候这些信息就消失了。我试过用AI写爬虫来自动化，但维护成本太高，最后还是手动。'
source_note: VC分析师个人访谈，脱敏处理，2024年

title: AI Newsletter + Twitter List作为低成本替代追踪方案
raw_text: Among early-stage investors who cannot afford Bloomberg or PitchBook, a common workaround is subscribing to 5-10 curated AI newsletters (The Batch, Import AI, Alpha Signal, etc.) and maintaining private Twitter/X lists of AI founders and researchers. This approach costs $0-200/month but requires 2-3 hours daily to process. An investor with 8K Twitter followers described: 'I have a list of 400 AI accounts I check every morning. It works but it's not scalable. I miss things constantly. If I could get a digest that surfaces only the signal and filters noise automatically, I would pay $200-500/month for it without hesitation.'
